name: openvino
description: OpenVINO™ is an open source toolkit for optimizing and deploying AI inference
one_liner: A toolkit that makes AI models run faster and cheaper on ordinary computer chips, instead of needing expensive specialized hardware in the cloud.
buyer: A manufacturing or retail company that wants AI features (like camera-based defect detection) running on local devices on the factory floor, not in the cloud.
business_use_cases: A machine-vision integrator deploys AI defect-detection on factory cameras using it to avoid per-inference cloud costs.
A hardware vendor sells AI-enabled devices (kiosks, cameras) that run entirely offline using this under the hood.
A privacy-focused software vendor sells an on-premise AI product to clients who are legally barred from sending data to the cloud.

money_ideas.idea: One-off integration projects for companies needing offline AI inference
A licensed, supported on-premise AI appliance built on top of it

steal_this: It's an enterprise infrastructure tool, not a weekend build; the realistic move is pitching 'offline AI inference setup' as a specialized service to one local manufacturer.
